strings.Muchos reprogramadores utilizan sus banc: Many tuners use their test benches only as an advertising argument, or as a sheet of paper on which to print a remap, but for us a dynamometer is much more than that! It is an essential tool, like a doctor's stethoscope, needed to tune an engine perfectly. Because we want to improve engine efficiency across the whole rev range and every parameter, we need to know power and torque at every engine speed. There are also many other parameters we can adapt to your driving needs, such as fuel pressure, air mass, total engine load, air-fuel ratio, ignition on petrol engines, injection timing, etc.
strings.Tenemos un banco de potencia 4x4 de últi: We have a latest-generation DYNOSTAR 4x4 dynamometer that can measure up to 1341 hp with an accuracy of ±1%. Because some high-performance engines only deliver their maximum power at high speeds (for example the BMW M3 V8) and because of the effect of moving air, we have installed a Sodeca system with two fans of 22 kW and 44 kW (90 hp in total) that can deliver up to 80,000 m³/h at 200 km/h, to perfectly simulate the airflow the intercoolers need to feed the engine during dyno runs.

strings.Las preguntas que más nos hacéis sobre l: The questions you ask us most about ECU remapping.
strings.¿Qué es la reprogramación y cómo funcion: What is ECU remapping and how does it work?
strings.Cada motor de inyección está equipado co: Every fuel-injected engine has an ECU (Electronic Control Unit) that controls ignition, injection and the air-fuel ratio. This ECU contains all the operating settings the engine needs. We rewrite the data in this chip so the engine benefits from an individually optimised operating program.
strings.¿Cuánto tiempo lleva el proceso de repro: How long does the remapping process take?
strings.Después de concretar una cita, trabajamo: Once the appointment is booked, we work on the car for about 2-3 hours (some cars take longer). We tune every car individually, and several adjustments are often needed before the result is perfect. We only hand the car back when we are happy with the result; it has to be perfect. Our customers are always welcome to stay and watch what happens to their car.
strings.¿Por qué cada coche necesita un software: Why does every car need custom software, tested on a reliable dynamometer?
strings.Cada motor es diferente, cada inyector e: Every engine is different, every injector is different, every turbo is different... Mass production means fairly large manufacturing tolerances. It simply takes a lot of time and money to develop each engine individually. Because manufacturers build engines with positive and negative tolerances, they also have to leave large margins in the software! By analysing each car individually we can offer great safety, plenty of power and more torque. Tuners who use a standard remap do not get their extra power from fine tuning, but simply from very high boost pressure, which of course is not good for engine life! People sometimes ask how remapped car X can have the same power as remapped car Y but cost only half as much. The answer is easy: it is simply a different tune with the same power, yes, but the difference lies in reliability, driveability, fuel consumption, etc. Buy cheap, buy twice!

strings.¿Qué consecuencias hay sobre la garantía: What are the consequences for the factory warranty?
strings.La garantía de fábrica de un vehículo nu: The factory warranty on a new vehicle is a legal requirement in the member states of the European Union, so a manufacturer cannot refuse warranty just because it finds that a vehicle has been modified. To refuse warranty, the manufacturer must find a direct link between the modification and the damage. As our Stage 1 modification stays within factory tolerances and is completely safe, there is no reason for the manufacturer to refuse warranty. If a manufacturer were determined to refuse warranty because the car has been modified, that would not be legal and could be challenged in court. In any case, it is best to avoid a costly and slow legal dispute, so we always try to make our modification completely invisible to the dealer, leaving no risk of losing the warranty. There are, however, some exceptions where the dealer can detect the modification, but there is a way round this, for example reinstalling the original software before going to the dealer for warranty work. It is always highly recommended to contact us first and visit the dealer afterwards for a warranty claim; that is the best way to be fully informed about the steps to follow.
strings.¿Existen consecuencias con el seguro?: Are there consequences for my insurance?
strings.La mayoría de las compañías de seguros c: Most insurance companies base their premiums on the price of the vehicle, the driver's age and the theft/claims rate, not on the vehicle's power.
strings.¿Existen consecuencias sobre el impuesto: Are there consequences for road tax?
strings.No. El impuesto de circulación se calcul: No. Spanish road tax is calculated on fiscal horsepower.
strings.¿Qué pasa si me hacen una actualización: What happens if my car gets a software update?
strings.Con automóviles nuevos es posible que re: New cars may receive an update. If this happens, you can have the car remapped again with your software, of course... free of charge.
strings.Nuestra Stage 1 se desarrolla de una man: Our Stage 1 is developed so that we always stay within the car's safety limits. Stage 1 is 100% reliable and we guarantee the same service life for the engine.
strings.¿Cuál es la diferencia entre la reprogra: What is the difference between remapping and a tuning box?
strings.Una \"centralita externa\" o \"centralit: A "tuning box" or "piggyback module" is a small module connected to the car's engine wiring. When we remap a car, we optimise the software in the EEPROM (the chip or internal memory of the original ECU). A tuning box only alters the values sent to the engine ECU; in fact, it tricks the car's original ECU. That is not the right way to tune a car and it can carry several risks... which is why we do not sell them :)
strings.¿Ofrecemos la posibilidad de utilizar Et: We offer the option of running on ethanol (E85), but there are some rules to follow...
strings.El Etanol (E85) ofrece la ventaja de ten: Ethanol (E85) has the advantage of a lower price than conventional fuel, but using it can put the engine at risk if the car is not fitted with an ethanol sensor. This sensor measures the ethanol level in the tank in real time, so the ECU (engine control unit) can adjust how the engine runs to get the best possible performance.
strings.Sin la presencia de este sensor, corres: Without this sensor, you risk damaging the engine or having it or other engine components run badly because of a poor mix of the two fuels (e.g. difficult cold starts, ignition problems, engine knock, engine warning lights, etc.)
strings.Tras varios años de investigación y desa: After several years of research and development, MIDO Performance has developed an ethanol conversion for certain engines that includes fitting this sensor. These vehicles can therefore run on ethanol and remain efficient and reliable.

strings.Una y otra vez MIDO Performance intenta: Time and again, MIDO Performance tries to innovate and find creative solutions to give every engine even better performance. Together with partner brands such as Milltek, Loba turbochargers, BMC air filters and Forge intercoolers... we try to develop products that are competent and a real improvement for the engine. For example, in 2003 we designed and tested the first DPF replacement parts for Milltek, and in 2010 the racing exhaust for the Golf 6 GTI. In our own workshop we also develop special engine and turbo kits, such as the GT16/20, GT17/20, GT18/20 and GT17/22 hybrid turbos... which many other tuners have bought.
